# Vishwaharsh Ayurved (विश्वहर्ष आयुर्वेद)

> Ayurvedic clinic in Chinchwad, Pimpri-Chinchwad (Pune), Maharashtra, India, led by Dr. Harshada Malge (BAMS, MD Ayurveda, PGDCP counselling psychology; Reg. I-74724-A; 10 years' experience). Personalised, root-cause Ayurvedic care in Marathi, Hindi and English.

## Facts
- Address: Shop no. 4, Shiwale Estate, Shivaji Park, Walhekarwadi Road, Chinchwad, Maharashtra 411033
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 81692 27140
- Email: harshadamalgepatil@gmail.com
- Hours: Mon–Sat 10:00–13:00 and 17:00–21:00; Sunday 17:00–21:00
- Book at least 1 day ahead; the clinic calls to confirm within 1 working day. Follow-up patients pay no consultation fee, only medicines.
- Consultation modes: in-clinic, home visit, online/video, WhatsApp follow-up, medicine courier across India and abroad.

## Specialisations
- Psychological conditions (anxiety, depression, stress, ADHD, autism support)
- Diabetes management (alongside, never replacing, physician-prescribed medication)
- Garbhsanskar (prenatal wellness) and Beejsanskar (preconception care)
- Panchakarma therapy with in-house theatre, Swedana and dispensary

## Products (dispensed under doctor's guidance)
Swarnprashan drops, Kumkumadi Tailam, Abhyangini ubtan, Mukhkanti Lepa
